build_note: 2026-10-12 spec (Spec 002 Phase 7 follow-up): claims written and assessed at after_specify BEFORE any implementation, per claims-precede-code. Requirements source: specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §4.7, §4.8, §2.3 friction (1) (2) (5) (6).

boundary: Scope: bundles exported by tekmerion.export after this change, and RunResult objects returned by tekmerion.verdicts.evaluate_run. Pre-change bundles are CLM-011-08's scope, not this claim's.
falsification_tests: F-011-1: an exported bundle of a study with registered controls whose run_outcome lacks a per-control entry for any registered control, or records an observed/passed value that a production-path execution of that control does not produce.
claims.text: Every bundle exported after this change records, in verdicts.json's run_outcome, one outcome entry per registered control — kind, failure mode, expected, observed, pass/fail (or an explicit non-executed attestation with passed: null), and fixture identity — for valid, invalid, and not-run outcomes alike; the same outcomes are carried on the run's own RunResult for live consumers.

boundary: Scope: tekmerion.verdicts.run_controls / run_controls_report behavioral parity. The report's additional structured fields are additive and outside the legacy contract.
falsification_tests: F-011-2: any control input (missing fixture, verdict mismatch, unknown kind, swap variants) whose failure list from run_controls differs in content or order from the pre-change implementation's.
claims.text: run_controls' failure contract is preserved exactly — same failure strings, same order, same conditions — with the structured report and the legacy function executing one and the same control path (RT-1).

boundary: Scope: tekmerion.export.verify_bundle. Fixture controls' observed verdicts are attested by the export-time production-path execution and bound by the manifest hashes — not recomputable bundle-alone (fixtures are registration-external); the swap outcome is fully recomputed.
falsification_tests: F-011-3: a bundle whose recorded control outcomes were altered (outcome flipped, control dropped, swap result misstated) and whose manifest was rehashed to match, passing verify_bundle.
claims.text: The standalone verifier fails a bundle whose recorded control outcomes contradict the bundle's own committed registration, its stated run outcome, or the verifier's own swap-control replay on the bundle's ledger copy; bundles without recorded outcomes verify as before.

boundary: Scope: tekmerion.verification.to_evidence_item with the claim supplied, and the shared register rebuild (ui/state.py::derive_evidence) that supplies it. Conversions without the claim keep the pre-change behavior.

evidence.ref: specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/corpus.md (CLM-E-004's registered falsifier names the Wandel 2010 conclusion — the pattern this rule fires on)

falsification_tests: F-011-4: a fixture in which a claim's falsifier names a record by DOI or first-author surname + year, the record resolves, agrees, and content-contradicts, and the converted evidence (or the claim's verdict) does not carry the falsifier observation / does not verdict via the falsifier path.
claims.text: Pipeline-converted evidence carries falsifier_observation=True exactly when the registered falsifier names the resolved record (by DOI, or by first-author surname + year) and that record resolved, agreed, and content-contradicts — so a claim whose falsifier is observed verdicts CONTRADICTED via the falsifier path, with the falsifier reason stated.

boundary: Scope: the falsifier wiring's boundary. Precision over recall by design: the falsifier path bypasses the sufficiency floor, so a false firing is worse than an unset flag.
falsification_tests: F-011-5: any battery case outside the naming rule's conjunction whose converted evidence carries falsifier_observation=True; or any change in evaluate_claim's outputs (verdict, interval, point) for identical group inputs.
claims.text: In every other case the flag stays unset — generic falsifiers, title-only naming, unresolved or disagreeing citations, metadata-only evidence, and conversions without the resolved record — and no verdict mathematics (intervals, points, floors, caps, thresholds) changes.

boundary: Scope: exports whose caller presents citation inputs (the workspace exporter passes the study's citation sidecar by default). Exports without presented inputs carry no as_cited key — absence noted, not failed (CLM-011-08's convention).

evidence.ref: specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.3 friction (5) (as-cited forms absent from the Phase 7 bundle)

falsification_tests: F-011-6: a bundle exported with citation inputs presented whose verification.json lacks an as-cited form for any presented citation; or a bundle whose as-cited form was altered (claim linkage changed) and rehashed, passing verify_bundle.
claims.text: When citation inputs are presented at export, the bundle's verification.json carries every citation's as-cited form, and the standalone verifier fails a bundle whose as-cited form disagrees with the ledger (unknown citation, or a claim linkage different from its citation.checked outcome).

boundary: Scope: decided quarantine items with decision 'exclude'. Grouping decisions and variant rulings are not exclusions and mint no markers; undecided items mint none.

evidence.ref: specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.3 friction (6) (excluded citations vanish without a marker)

falsification_tests: F-011-7: a bundle in which an adjudicated-excluded citation has no marker, a marker exists for a citation no decided quarantine item excluded, or a marker's rationale/queue item diverges from the ledger — passing verify_bundle after rehash.
claims.text: The bundle's adjudication.json carries an exclusion marker (citation, claim, queue item, decision, rationale) for exactly the citations a decided quarantine item excluded — no more, no fewer — the verifier re-derives the set from the ledger replay and fails on any divergence, and excluded citations remain absent from the evidence files.

boundary: Scope: verify_bundle over the eight named frozen bundles (verdicts pinned to the values recorded at baseline, before this change: demo bundles carry no issued verdicts; math CLM-M-110/210 contested, -310/-410 inconclusive, -510 inconclusive→supported across its two verdict events; Phase 7 supported/supported/inconclusive/contradicted/inconclusive). Out-of-repo bundle sets are verified when present; the Phase 7 pair is in-repo.
falsification_tests: F-011-8: any of the eight frozen bundles failing verify_bundle under the new code, or verifying with any issued verdict different from its recorded value; or a pre-change-shaped bundle (new keys stripped, manifest rehashed) failing on the absence of a new field.
claims.text: Backward compatibility: all eight previously frozen bundles (Phase 5 demo v1–v4, Spec 003 math study v1–v2, Phase 7 evaluation v1–v2) verify standalone under the new code with their issued verdicts byte-identical, and a bundle lacking any of the new fields verifies as before, with the absences noted in the verifier's checks rather than failed.

boundary: Scope: the README text of newly exported bundles. Frozen bundles' READMEs are frozen artifacts and are not rewritten.

evidence.ref: specs/002-mvp-implementation/evaluation/EVALUATION-REPORT.md §2.3 friction (6) (CIT-E-302 metadata_only vs contextual, no stated mapping)

falsification_tests: F-011-9: a bundle exported after this change whose HUMAN-README does not state the conversion mapping; or a stated mapping that disagrees with to_evidence_item's actual conversion on any row.
claims.text: The exported bundle's HUMAN-README states the pipeline's content-outcome → evidence conversion mapping (supports / contradicts / contextual / metadata_only / quarantined → stance, mass, and flags), so no bundle file's vocabulary is left unmapped against another's.
